title: Orbs appearing inside Bledsoe's house

tellings.quote: just about every day of my life. and it comes in my house. Orbs appearing in my room over my chairs and flying through the house and stuff.

plain: Since 2007, orbs of light have come into Chris Bledsoe's North Carolina home "just about every day of my life", appearing in his room over his chairs and flying through the house, he tells Michels. Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs show up around him and whom NASA has studied, says he sees this himself. If true, it would mean that whatever follows him comes right into his house.
